title: kv: introduce pinned-window keeper and fragmentation prober to reduce spill flapping
author: Marina Kwon
description: This PR adds a low-latency eviction layer called the pinned-window keeper and a lightweight fragmentation prober that together reduce repetitive spillover (spill flapping) under mixed workloads. Motivation: production traces showed frequent tiny spill cycles where fragmented pages triggered repeated disk spill and refill, increasing tail latency and IO churn. The pinned-window keeper keeps a small sliding protection window for recently active spans and uses tenant-aware scoring to avoid evicting defensively hot fragments. The fragmentation prober runs as a cooperative background task that samples slot layouts and emits coalescing hints; when safe it consolidates adjacent small fragments into a reclaimable page to reduce future spills. To minimize interference with token-serving latency, eviction/compaction work is scheduled via batch-aware background workers that respect in-flight request budgets and kernel affinity hints. The change includes: 1) pinned-window keeper implementation and configuration knobs, 2) prober module with metrics and an adaptive sampling policy, 3) a new batch-aware eviction scheduler hook to delay heavy compaction during peak token emission, 4) observability additions (eviction/migration counters, fragmentation score gauge), and 5) a microbenchmark and an integration test that reproduces spill flapping. The description below lists commits, changed areas, and review thread. Note: no API breaking changes; config defaults are conservative.

review_comments: Ethan Zhou (review): overall idea looks solid. Please add latency-oriented benchmarks that measure 99th percentile token latency during compaction windows. Concern: pinned window default size might be too conservative for small tenants.

Marina Kwon (author): responded that bench harness added simulates 99/99.9p tail and results included in bench output. Default pinned window chosen from observed median span lifetime; will make config per-tenant in follow-up.
Sofia Patel (review): Can we ensure prober sampling doesn't add CPU jitter during hot routing? Suggest moving sampling to a token-quiet worker and gating with the scheduler.
Marina Kwon (author): implemented scheduler gating in second commit; prober yields to batch-aware worker and backpressure is tracked via the scheduler token budget.
Diego Ramos (review): tests look good. Minor nit: rename fragmentation score to frag_score for consistency with metrics dashboard naming conventions.
Marina Kwon (author): updated metric name and documented it in docs/ops/kv_tuning.md. All comments addressed.
CI Bot: initial CI run failed on lint in src/kv/pinned_window.rs (unused import). Marina fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran. CI now passes.
release_notes: Improves KV cache stability under fragmented workloads by introducing a pinned-window protection policy and a background fragmentation prober. Reduces repeated spill cycles and lowers tail latency; conservative defaults applied. Operators can tune pinned_window.size and prober.sample_rate.
